recipes.name: Miso-glazed salmon with greens
recipes.method_note: The glaze catches fast under the grill. Stay close for the last minutes.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}. Cook following the packet.
Heat the grill to high. Line a tray with foil.
Mix {{ing:miso-paste}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}} in a cup.
Put {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on the tray. Spread the miso mix over the tops.
Grill for 8 minutes, until dark at the edges and flaking.
Halve {{ing:pak-choi}}. Steam or boil for 3 minutes, until the stems are tender.
Slice {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Serve salmon on the rice. Scatter over spring onion and {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

recipes.name: Miso soup with tofu
recipes.method_note: Miso is added off the boil. Boiling it dulls the flavour.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:tofu-firm}} into small cubes. Slice {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Bring {{ing:water}} to a simmer (small bubbles) in a pan.
Add the tofu and {{ing:spinach}}. Cook 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts.
Take off the heat. Put {{ing:miso-paste}} in a ladle.
Lower the ladle into the soup. Stir until the miso dissolves.
Stir in {{ing:soy-sauce}}. Serve topped with the spring onion.

recipes.name: Crumbed chicken with katsu-style curry sauce
recipes.method_note: The sauce is a mild, sweet curry. Blend it for a smooth finish, or leave it chunky.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Put a pan on a medium heat with 1 tablespoon of the oil.
Fry the vegetables for 8 minutes, until the onion is soft.
Stir in {{ing:curry-powder}} and 1 tablespoon of the flour. Cook 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:stock-chicken}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}.
Simmer (small bubbles) for 15 minutes, until thick like gravy.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Slice each of {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} in half through the middle, making thin pieces.
Put the rest of the flour on a plate. Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} in a bowl.
Put {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} on another plate.
Coat each piece in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat the rest of {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Fry the chicken 4 minutes each side, until golden and white all through.
Slice the chicken. Serve on the rice with the sauce over.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon with rice and greens
recipes.method_note: The sauce thickens fast once the honey is in. Keep stirring and take it off as soon as it is glossy.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Grate {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} into a jug.
Add {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:rice-vinegar}} and 3 tablespoons of water.
Stir in {{ing:cornflour}} until smooth.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium-high heat.
Fry {{ing:salmon-fillet}} skin side down 4 minutes, until crisp.
Turn. Pour in the sauce. Bubble 2 minutes, spooning it over, until glossy.
Cut {{ing:broccoli-head}} into florets. Steam or boil 4 minutes.
Serve salmon on the rice with the broccoli. Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.
